docs.title: Chameleon UI
docs.expanding: This site shows the live workspace catalog (v2.0). Counts below are measured from catalog.json, not aspirational. A/B family gaps are not registered because those folders are not on disk. Freeze-meeting sign-off remains unsigned (owner 待指定). The 8 official homage themes were cleared by the project owner on 2026-08-13 and ship as free themes.
docs.componentsCount: {count} components (catalog v2.0; A/B gaps still open)
docs.legalThemes: Official homage ids (line, silver-arrow, stuttgart, corsa, cupertino, siren, wechat, ant-blue) were cleared by the project owner on 2026-08-13. That is owner confirmation, not a law-firm opinion letter. They ship as free official themes. Community packs may be free or paid. Do not claim unmeasured recognition rates.
docs.previewPending: No live preview for this slug yet. Contract docs still apply.
docs.installHint: This copies a CLI command. The CLI is a thin shell over install-core — the only disk writer. Docs never writes files itself.
docs.schemaLead: component-contract schema v0.1 is served from this site with no login.
docs.schemaUrl: Local path: /schemas/component-contract/v0.1.json. $id remains https://chameleon-ui.dev/schemas/component-contract/v0.1.json. That host is not deployed from this local R&D repo.
docs.schemaBreak: Breaking changes require a new path /schemas/component-contract/v0.2.json and a new $id. v0.1 stays readable.
docs.benchLead: GenUI-Bench is a local harness. Numbers come from running install-core against the live registry. This page does not invent Lighthouse or install rates.
docs.telemetryLead: Telemetry notice v1 (telemetry-notice.v1). Off by default. No source code is collected.
docs.telemetryOff: Opt out: chameleon telemetry-off (emits opt_out when a hook is present).
docs.homeLead: MIT-licensed React components on Ark/Zag primitives. Install from the official packages. Inner demo stays at port 5175; this docs site is 5176.
docs.themesLead: Overlay themes from @chameleon-ui/themes (8 official homage themes, free). Cleared by the project owner for official shipping; do not claim recognition rates. Community marketplace packs may be free or paid.
docs.localesLead: Product locales ship beside each component (21). The docs site UI has three first-class languages: Simplified Chinese (default), Traditional Chinese (zh-HK), and English. This is not a 21-language docs site.
docs.installLead: Use the CLI or MCP. Both call install-core. There is no third installer on this site.
docs.npmNote: Packages are publish-ready (MIT, publishConfig.access=public) at version 0.0.0. This repo does not npm publish until maintainers freeze v0.1.0.
docs.skeletonNotice: Docs chrome for this locale is an English ICU skeleton, not a translation. See the locale gap table (LEGACY-2026-004).
docs.vpatLead: Draft VPAT published on this site. status=draft. Not certified. Not legally signed. No Lighthouse scores.
docs.dashboardLead: Read-only north-star board. Consumes bench.* from the local GenUI-Bench report and telemetry.* dictionary names. Empty state is valid. No new event names.
docs.dashboardEmpty: No live telemetry stream. CU_TELEMETRY defaults to off. Metrics below stay empty until a report is present.
docs.dashboardBenchMissing: bench/latest.json is not on this docs origin. Run bench:genui then rebuild docs, or use the empty state.
docs.gapsLead: Language × page gap table. Non-green cells use LEGACY-* + ETA + owner=待指定. Marketing pages are not claimed complete.
docs.gapsMarketing: Marketing pages are out of scope (LEGACY-2026-005). Do not treat the home kicker as a shipped campaign site.
docs.familyPlanned: Planned — no components shipped in this family yet (Phase 6).
